verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payment-network/authentication layer (tokens, mandates, credentials, step-up auth) — order fulfillment status and shipment tracking are merchant/logistics concerns entirely outside its product category, not something a payment rail exposes. The one post-purchase mention ('confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions') refers to payment confirmation and dispute-signal capture, not order/shipping tracking, so this axis does not apply to this type of product.
